translations.将以下范围全部标为本地已读（包含所有分页）？: Mark all local messages in the following folders as read (all pages)?
translations.部分文件夹失败，请刷新后重试: Some folders failed; refresh and retry
translations.主动打开邮件会标为本地已读；账号数字表示收件箱未读数。: Opening a message marks it read locally; account badges show inbox unread counts.
translations.首次使用,请创建管理员账号(密码至少8位): First use: create an administrator account (minimum 8 characters)
translations.还没有添加任何邮箱账号 ·: No mail account has been added ·
translations.只同步最近多少天: Only sync the most recent days
translations.填写 Google 应用专用密码（16位），不是 Google 登录密码；需先开: Enter a Google app password (16 digits), not your Google sign-in password. Two-Step Verification is required.
translations.使用OAuth2授权，支持离线自动刷新访问令牌；需要已配置 HTTPS 回调地址: Uses OAuth2 with offline token refresh; a configured HTTPS callback URL is required.
translations.这里修改的是本地 Dovecot 用户: This changes the login password for local Dovecot user
translations.默认同步间隔(新建账号时的初始值): Default sync interval for new accounts
translations.保存后刷新页面生效。: Save and refresh the page to apply.
translations.服务器会保留最近7天的恢复前快照：: The server keeps pre-restore snapshots for 7 days:
translations.每行一个完整名称，例如： INBOX Sent: One full name per line, for example: INBOX Sent
translations.每行一个完整名称，例如： Trash Junk: One full name per line, for example: Trash Junk
translations.该 Provider 使用 OAuth2。保存后会跳转到服务商授权页面；请先在: This provider uses OAuth2. After saving, you will be redirected to its authorization page. First configure the credentials on the
translations.配置对应的 Client ID、Client Secret 和回调地址。: with the corresponding Client ID, Client Secret, and callback URL.
translations.隔离模式会把该账号的完整文件夹层级放到一个独立顶层文件夹中；原样汇聚可能与其他账: Isolation places this account's complete folder hierarchy under a separate top-level folder. Merging may combine same-named folders from different accounts.
translations.修改已同步账号的策略会清除可重建的同步缓存，下次重新同步到新位置；旧位置中的邮件: Changing this policy clears rebuildable sync cache and syncs to the new location next time. Messages in the old location are not deleted automatically.
translations.留空表示同步全部文件夹。名称按源邮箱中显示的完整路径精确匹配。: Leave blank to sync all folders. Names must exactly match the full paths shown by the source mailbox.
translations.排除规则优先；这里不会删除源邮箱中的任何内容。: Exclusion rules take priority. Nothing in the source mailbox is deleted.
translations.镜像模式会永久删除本地目标端中源端已不存在的邮件，但绝不会删除源邮箱邮件。仅账号: Mirror mode permanently deletes local destination messages that no longer exist at the source, but never deletes source messages. Available only with account isolation.
translations.⚠ 镜像删除已开启。首次正式同步前建议先完成备份并查看同步日志；此模式不能同时设: ⚠ Mirror deletion is enabled. Back up and review the sync log before the first production sync. Message age and size limits cannot be used in this mode.
translations.所有未单独配置目标用户的外部邮箱，默认同步到此本地 Dovecot 用户。已单独: External mailboxes without their own destination user sync to this local Dovecot user by default. Accounts with a specific destination do not follow this change.
translations.保存后仅影响新建账号的默认值,不会修改已有账号。: This changes only the default for new accounts; existing accounts are not modified.
translations.保存后刷新页面生效。当前页面会继续使用切换前的语言。: Save and refresh the page to apply. This page continues using the previous language until refreshed.
translations.留空则保留现有密钥: Leave blank to keep the existing secret
translations.修改会先验证当前密码，写入新密码后立即用新密码实际尝试登录一次确认生效， 整个过: The current password is verified first. After writing the new password, the application immediately performs a real login. Dovecot and local-target.pass remain consistent, and any failure is rolled back.
translations.VM 内存有限时建议保持 1~2,避免多个 imapsync 同时跑爆内存: Use 1–2 on a memory-constrained VM to avoid concurrent imapsync processes exhausting memory.
translations.默认 120 分钟；超时后先请求退出，10 秒后仍未结束则强制终止: Default: 120 minutes. On timeout, graceful exit is requested first and the process is forced to stop after 10 more seconds.
translations.默认 90 天；服务启动时及之后每 24 小时自动清理已结束任务和对应日志，不会: Default: 90 days. Completed jobs and logs are cleaned at startup and every 24 hours; queued and running jobs are preserved.
translations.修改后立即生效,不需要重启服务。已有账号的间隔不受影响。: Applies immediately without a restart. Existing account intervals are unchanged.
translations.⚠️ 修改端口后需要重启服务才会生效,保存后请点击下方「重启服务」或手动执行: ⚠️ Port changes require a service restart. After saving, use Restart service below or run
translations.需要先分别在 Google Cloud 和 Microsoft Entra 注册: Register Web applications in Google Cloud and Microsoft Entra, then add the callback URLs below exactly as shown. Client secrets are stored only in server files with mode 600 and are never displayed.
translations.正式环境必须使用 HTTPS，不要带路径；仅 localhost/127.0.0: Production must use HTTPS without a path. HTTP is allowed only for localhost/127.0.0.1 testing.
translations.个人 Outlook 和多租户一般使用 common；企业也可以填写租户 ID: Personal Outlook and multi-tenant applications usually use common; organizations may enter a tenant ID or domain.
translations.会发送 JSON 事件，不会包含邮箱密码或授权码。: Sends JSON events without mailbox passwords or app passwords.
translations.同一账号连续失败时，在冷却时间内仅发送一次通知。: Repeated failures for one account send only one notification during the cooldown period.
translations.修改后立即生效,刷新页面就能看到,不需要重启服务。: Applies immediately; refresh the page to see it. No service restart is required.
translations.备份包含账号数据库、邮箱密码/授权码和通知密钥，不包含邮件正文、日志、缓存或会话: The backup contains the account database, mailbox credentials, and notification secrets. It excludes message bodies, logs, cache, and session signing data. Store it encrypted offline and never upload it to a public repository.
translations.先上传并只读预检，不会立刻改动系统。正式恢复前会自动保存当前数据库和密钥快照；邮: Upload and perform a read-only inspection first. Before restoration, the current database and secrets are snapshotted automatically. Message bodies, the current administrator, sessions, and the current local Dovecot password are preserved.
translations.只会重启 mail-aggregator 这一个服务,不影响 Dovecot 和: Restarts only mail-aggregator and does not affect Dovecot or other services. The minimal sudo permission described in the README is required; otherwise run
translations.卸载操作不可通过网页撤销。程序卸载会删除 Mail Aggregator 和运行: Uninstallation cannot be undone from the Web UI. Application removal deletes Mail Aggregator and its runtime data but preserves Dovecot and mail. Full removal also deletes Dovecot, the local mailbox user, and all messages in Maildir.
translations.这里显示已同步到本机 Dovecot 的邮件，只读查看不会修改邮箱内容。: Messages synchronized to local Dovecot appear here. Read-only viewing does not modify mailbox contents.
translations.选择一封邮件查看正文: Select a message to read it
translations.远程图片可能让发件人知道你打开了邮件，并看到你的网络地址。: Remote images may tell the sender that you opened the message and reveal your network address.
translations.内嵌图片和安全排版已还原；脚本、表单、外部样式和危险布局始终被屏蔽。: Embedded images and safe formatting are preserved; scripts, forms, external styles, and dangerous layouts are always blocked.
translations.内嵌图片和安全排版已还原；远程图片仍被拦截，脚本和危险布局已移除。: Embedded images and safe formatting are preserved; remote images remain blocked, and scripts and dangerous layouts were removed.
translations.远程图片已由你主动加载；脚本、表单、外部样式和危险布局仍然被屏蔽。: You chose to load remote images; scripts, forms, external styles, and dangerous layouts remain blocked.
translations.这封邮件没有可显示的正文: This message has no displayable body
